title: A Busy Saturday
content:
On Saturday morning, Mia goes to the supermarket with **50 dollars** in her wallet.

First, she buys **2 apples** for **3 dollars** and **1 loaf of bread** for **4 dollars**.

Then, she sees her favorite chocolate. It costs **5 dollars**, so she puts **3 chocolate bars** in her basket.

“That's **15 dollars**!” she says.

Mia continues shopping. She buys **6 eggs** for **6 dollars** and a bottle of milk for **3 dollars**.

At the checkout, the cashier looks at her items.

“Your total is **31 dollars**,” he says.

Mia pays and checks her wallet.

She has **19 dollars** left.

On her way home, she stops at a small café. A cup of coffee costs **4 dollars**, and a piece of cake costs **6 dollars**.

She smiles.

“Only **10 dollars**,” she says.

At the end of the day, Mia has **9 dollars** left.

It was a simple day, but Mia learned an important lesson:

**Always check the price before you buy something!**
